question: What are the key catalysts for Diginex?

beats.line: Diginex faces execution milestones deciding whether the platform thesis gains traction.
beats.headline: EXECUTION MILESTONES
beats.action: A halftone paper checklist unrolls onto a cream chip and settles flat.

beats.line: Strategy updates land in the second quarter of twenty twenty-six.
beats.headline: Q2 2026
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the checklist folds into a single calendar page that drops to centre and holds.

beats.line: Four acquired businesses must run unified, not as separate silos.
beats.headline: 4 BUSINESSES
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the calendar page tears into four document blocks; a paper ribbon loops round and binds them together.

beats.line: Brazil's seventy-seven billion dollar sustainability market is the diversification play.
beats.headline: $77B BRAZIL
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the bound block flattens into a cutout map shape; a torn-paper arrow enters, points into it and stops.

beats.line: The one point five billion Resulticks deal is the transformative bet.
beats.headline: $1.5B BET
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the map shape curls into one large paper coin; a document lands beside it and holds.

beats.line: Without cross-sell evidence, it becomes a burden, not an unlock.
beats.headline: CROSS-SELL OR BURDEN
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the large coin splits; half becomes a paper key that fails to turn, taped shut at frame centre.

beats.line: Revenue grew two hundred and ninety-three percent to two million dollars.
beats.headline: +293% YOY
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the taped key straightens into a rising paper bar; coins stack along it and settle at the top.

beats.line: October's warrant exercise raised thirteen point eight million in cash.
beats.headline: +$13.8M
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the rising bar folds into a paper vault door; fresh coins slide in behind it and rest.

beats.line: At a thirty-four million market cap, Diginex is priced for scepticism.
beats.headline: $34M MARKET CAP
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the vault door contracts into one shrunken coin; a paper price tag drops onto it and hangs still.

beats.line: The next six to nine months are make-or-break.
beats.headline: 6–9 MONTHS
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the price tag fans into nine calendar pages; a paper hand enters and holds over the last one.
